== Summary ==
Slip “Attack Pattern Delta” cut unchanged from page 4 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF file created 6 October 2023), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (590, 1290, 1102, 1575)). Version [[Attack Pattern Delta (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
